environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group (priority 1, action BLOCK) that uses a RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string component with transformation TEXT/URL_DECODE applied twice (nested), matching the pattern `(?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|xp_)`. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (tasks run in private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound), and the container runs with a read-only root filesystem with /data mounted as an EFS volume. The SQLite database file on EFS has POSIX permissions 0644 owned by root, while the container process runs as UID 1000 (non-root).

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for egress
